faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Raja Jwala Prasad Post-Doctoral Fellowship?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Raja Jwala Prasad Post-Doctoral Fellowship at Banaras Hindu University is 28th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this fellowship?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a PhD in Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Zoology, Microbiology, Cellular & Molecular Biology, or Life Science from a recognized Indian university or institute with a NIRF ranking up to 20, or a PhD from abroad.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Raja Jwala Prasad Post-Doctoral Fellowship?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this fellowship is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/Female/Physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this fellowship?
faq.answer: The fellowship offers a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 70,000, along with HRA and contingency allowances.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this fellowship?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, and submit it via Speed Post or Registered Post before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Raja Jwala Prasad Post-Doctoral Fellowship?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is SRICC/IoE/RJP-PDF/2026-27/3298.

faq.question: Q9. Which university is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Banaras Hindu University (BHU) is conducting this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this fellowship?
faq.answer: The job type for the Raja Jwala Prasad Post-Doctoral Fellowship is contractual.
